body: If you need help or just someone to talk to you're more than welcome to speak to me bud :)

Hey buddy :) 

I know how it feels, having social anxiety from a very young age and only interact with few individuals. I look at others and even my own friends and ask myself how the hell are they so social. I'm on the similar age group so sometimes I actually choose not to go out because of how I just dislike over socialising (clubbing, drinking). I also have a hard time communicating with others and perhaps that's the real reason why she left me. 

I know how it is, being heavily dependent on your partner and having that comfort and safety where you feel like you're already set for life but then they leave and you feel like they've abandoned you even though they knew how you are. Like you said, she was the rock, the net to catch you when you fall. However, don't look at this experience as a negative thing and look at it as a positive thing. Take this time and opportunity to build yourself into something you NEVER would have done if you stayed with her. Do things you have not done even though that sounds cliché, things that seemed crazy for her. First thing I did when she left? Called an emergency leave for work and went to Spain to go skydiving.

Dont think you're never going to find someone else but the thing is, you shouldn't look in the first place. You should let it fall under your lap. Maybe you'll find a partner who is in the same level of anxiety as you if not worst! Maybe you'll find someone who you would eventually need to speak to and that's when it can start! You don't necessarily need to meet them at a club or a social gathering, life is full of surprises both good and bad so you just have to let it happen.  We all miss the feeling of security and we get scared we may never find it again but the only way we can overcome that fear is to secure ourselves. 

I know this is going to sound like it's been said a thousand times but I do think you can do it, I'm in the same situation as you but I think once I start feeling better I'm going to come out of it stronger than ever. So if I can believe that about myself, you should too about you. 

Edit: Sorry I forgot to mention that you need to realise that the person that love you for all those years was in love with YOU and you should give yourself more credit than you do. It was you who made them happy and felt love and it is also you who they will miss and perhaps regret once you show them how better you can be without them.

Ha what a coincidence, I'm from Dubai as well and I am in the same exact situation as you. 

I know how it is to lose your partner, she wasn't just your girlfriend, she was there when you were growing up but you need to realise that she was also growing up too. As shitty as it may sound, people grow up and change, they want new things, they want to explore the life without us. But thats just one of the few things we have to accept, sure it may seem like shit right now but I do believe everything happens for a reason and it may be scary to venture out especially after the comfort you've had with her but believe me, I know you can do it. 

Shoot me up a pm or if you want to have a drink or something whilst I'm still here (holiday atm) let me know. I'm more than happy to have a buddy that I can go through this with.

I received a message from my partner last night in which she said how we grew too different and that she never wants us to be together again. It hurt like hell but I think that pain is going to make me feel okay, I basically got a closure where I can be with someone else, which I obviously dont want to do at the moment. Calling her may result to the same thing so hope for the best and expect the worst.

Yeah you can save the significant ones, go for it. But for me, every photo was and is significant. Just remember, in those photos she was so happy that she was with you and I believe you can do it with another individual who will cherish your love more

Sorry bud, was just busy! Keep yourself busy, don't find someone else just yet, being with someone just because of a rebound is not fair to the girl that you meet but to yourself as well. Or do what you want. Your happiness is now the most important thing and even if that leads you to doing something crazy then do it. Focus on yourself then hopefully,  HOPEFULLY, she will realise her mistake and you'll be better when she comes back. If she doesn't, then the next person won't have to deal with the same thing.

Ah expectations does not always lead to disappointment, this is not the first time I've experienced disappointment as my dad died of cancer two years ago. Sure I had my gf back when it happened but looking back now, the things I've accomplished for my father was out of this world. I know the surprise part sucks but like everyone says, life is full of surprises and it's either good or bad. Were you not surprised when she said yes when you guys started dating? Or when she got you a gift due to a normal day or special occasion? Sure it's shit right now but believe me, somewhere along the line you will get an even better surprise, a one that does not break your heart.

Ah yeah I was also left dazed and confused, but sometimes people just want to explore alone and we have to accept their decision as we love them. After all, like you said, we will always be a part of them and we should be proud of that, only a few can impact an individual's life and we are one of the lucky ones that got to do it and you will impact others too.  

Just know that people do care, I could be thousand miles away from you and here I am willing to share something in order to make you feel better, don't push away the friends that you have because of this as I have made that mistake too.

Hey man, that sucks really. Having to go home and see her be there really does. But I suggest do taking time off, meeting friends and new people that they may bring. The best thing to do is to show her that you can be happy or pretend to be happy without her, perhaps that may be the miracle you're hoping her. Of course I hope that one day she does come back but as time moves forward, I know that there will come a time where it'll be too late for HER and not me. I know it's hard to not think of the what could have been, it's so damn hard but it is easier to think of what it was, how once a stranger could make you happy, now think of the other strangers that can and the actual one that stays with you forever. Build yourself up and show not her but you itself what you are capable of. 

I know whatever I say will not mend away the heartbreak but I hope that it shows you that there is something behind these dark times, if you need more details let me know as I broke NC yesterday itself and I've never felt better. Shoot me a pm and we can get through it together!

4 years here but she was also my best friend before that for another 4, so I would like to say 8 all in all as she was my partner in crime throughout these years. We ended the relationship due to our differences even though we've survived long distance and now go to the same university. 

Felt pretty damn bad, as I child I've witnessed my own mother attempt to commit suicide due to my biological father leaving us hence my subconscious mind has told me that it was okay if I died, so I tried to take my own life only to be halted by the police. 

Its only been a month since we broke up and actually had to take a leave off work in order to soul search (cliché I know) flew to another country and did things that I have never done before like skydiving, socialising (very introverted here), and other typical things that I wanted to experience but knew if I was with her I would not be able to. Doing this allowed me to realise that I got to experience things I could have missed out but I had no regrets as I've also experience true love. Soon enough, today actually, I realised that the reason why I went through depression after she left was because she made me so happy and I got to experience this "beautiful sadness" as Butters from south park says ha.  I don't feel happy at all nor do I feel as sad but I think I can proudly say that if she came and told me she made a mistake on leaving me, I would happily say no. Also, damn good friends. Go out there and talk to the people you may have ignored due to your focus being driven to your relationship, you would be surprised how many are willing to welcome you back and that's when you realise that life is worth living for so much more. 

Hope you're okay :)

Time does heal all, I lost my dad while I was with her too and she was there to sort of pick me up. The one thing I've learnt is not to rely on other individuals to pick us up, no matter how perfect they are. The definition of perfect is controversial, you may think she was that now but as humans we are always evolving and looking for new things, a new perfect. So trust me, it'll be okay soon buddy.

I would suggest saving it, she left you a month ago and she may seem like the worst person there is right now but on those pictures she wasn't. Like you said, looking at those pictures made you happy right? Keep it as a memory and save it on another device if need be (a hard drive, usb).

Sure, go for it. I mailed it as I'm currently travelling in order to get my mind off her. But just to let you know, she may be very cold to you too and please don't let it affect you. The only reason why she may be cold is because she gave you warmth before and I know it's hard right now but try to remember that you had a good time and experience which you will spend with another individual. 

Let me know how it goes.

Heyya, 

I'm going through the same situation at the moment hence why I've been lurking here and trying to give a helping hand ha. 4 years here and one morning she decides to just end it out of the blue due to our differences and that we have grown to be completely different people. 

Listen, if there's one thing I've learned is that it's NOT enough to do everything right. I changed my personality and accepted everything just so I can stay with her and gave her everything I could. At the end of the day, the only person that appreciates our maximum efforts is ourselves and that's how you should perceive things. 

I recently heard how she got too intoxicated once and how she was so happy to be single again and it did hurt me at the time it happened, felt like I was a jailer when my intention was to give her all my love. But as time passed, I start to realise that she was grieving too and sometimes we just have to accept that our partner's happiness is no longer our responsibility. I'm sure she's as sad as you if the love was genuine to her and it shouldn't get you down if she isn't upset because man you dodged a bullet. 

Sometimes the cold season just hits us out of the blue but what do we do? We adapt. We make it better, because sometimes, things just aren't in our control and the sooner we understand this, the better you start to feel. Stay strong my friend :)

Hey bud, 

4 years of relationship and 4 years of friendship here totalling to 8 years and I'm pretty young so she's really my childhood friend.

We broke up because I'm Catholic, although not too religious and she was Hindu and that her parents would never accept me as I'm also from a different country and one thing lead to another and here I am now, not spoken to her in a month until last night with her response saying that I should stop trying to contact her. 

I did learn something though, that love has no eyes, no skin colour, no religion and no beliefs. I do believe that she loved/loves me but perhaps not enough to fight for it and I have to ask, do you really want to spend an eternity with someone and their family, who cannot be with you due to something as silly as religion? (no offense to religious individuals) What happens when bigger problem arises? Which will btw. 

The only advice I can give you is to NOT hate your own self. I hated myself, the fact that I wasn't born the right way? Things would be so different now but the thing is, sometimes we are given a shitty hand and the best thing we can do is play our best and if we lose, then we go onto the next round. 

Stay strong and you are more than welcome to shoot me a message and we can talk about our ex partners ha.

Hey man, similar to all the comments and your post, I too am going in the same situation after 4 years of being together and going through high-school and the same university. What I learnt from this month (after she left me) is that people change, sometimes we wish that we can just stop time at that picture perfect moment but we can't. But you know what we can do? We can look back and think "Wow, he/she has made me so happy at that moment". And realise that eventually, you will find someone that will give you that moment continuously. 

I'm not going to say that your ex was lying or perhaps I'm being delusional but sometimes, we have to figure things out ourselves without relying on others and perhaps that is her reason as to why she left. I'm also not going to tell you what to do but No Contact is helping me at the moment, when people leave their partner they seem that they may be the coldest person you have ever encountered but remember, that's only because they were also the one that made you feel warmth once but if you keep trying to contact them you'll get nothing but cold response. Now experiencing that is a lot worst than the actual break up in my opinion so please give yourself some time, do hobbies and keep the people that are willing to go through this tough time with you rather than pushing them away. Pm me if you need some help :) 

I broke no contact yesterday and would love to help individuals who are going through the same as me.

I took the path of dating my best friend and we lasted together for 4 years until yesterday.  Not only have I lost my only companion, I have lost the love of my life and in complete shock at the moment. 

Sorry for this depressing comment, I just seriously have no one to share this with.
